weapons.name: LASER weapon
weapons.shape: A compact ink laser emitter with an angular small body, short hand grip, long straight narrow forward barrel, two clearly separated concentric focusing collars near the muzzle. Clear long/slender silhouette, no scope.
weapons.prompt: Create ONE complete standalone LASER weapon inventory/HUD icon for DEVIANT. Reference 1 is the approved UI STYLE: creamy ivory filled silhouettes, dark charcoal bold outline, slightly organic hand-ink curves and crisp minimal details. Reference 2 is this game's actual pixel-art character holding the weapon; use its weapon silhouette identity only, do not include the character or pixel art. A compact ink laser emitter with an angular small body, short hand grip, long straight narrow forward barrel, two clearly separated concentric focusing collars near the muzzle. Clear long/slender silhouette, no scope. Diagonal orientation from lower-left grip to upper-right muzzle. The large circular weapon HUD must distinguish this from the ink ball gun, from the other ranged forms, and from loose bomb and shuriken. Only the complete weapon, 3-4 clean interior lines maximum, centered and large on a square transparent canvas with ample margins. No letters, stats, glyph badges, frame, disc, firing effect, glow, shadow, smoke, gradients outside silhouette, background, or other props. Flat ivory with a clear dark ink outline, clean true alpha background. This is a new independent asset, not extracted screen pixels.
